process.name: Internal weekly project-summary drafting
process.purpose: Prepare a first draft of an internal weekly project summary.
process.start_condition: The owner supplies a bounded set of fictional project notes.
process.finish_condition: A labeled draft is returned to the owner; the owner edits and manually shares it.
inputs: Fictional project notes supplied for the run.
outputs: A draft summary marked for owner review.
dependencies: Named owner review; local draft buffer.
process.desired_outcome: A consistent internal result with a named person accountable for consequential decisions.

touchpoints.description: A fictional accountable owner reviews the output.

candidate_decision.reason: Ready for Level 1 drafting only: a person reviews, edits, and manually shares every result. The scores are illustrative and do not authorize a higher level.

actions.action: Prepare an internal draft for the named owner to review.

read_permissions: Only the fictional process inputs provided for one run.

forbidden_data: Real customer, employee, credential, or confidential data.

action_boundary.customer_reputation_limit: No external communication or customer-visible change.
action_boundary.strategic_identity_limit: The accountable person retains all policy, identity, and judgment decisions.

escalation_path.response: Stop, preserve the draft, and request human review.

action_boundary.safe_state: No external action; retain a clearly labeled draft for human review.
permitted_tools_actions: Fictional local drafting interface for the supplied synthetic process inputs; no network access.

unknowns: READY means ready to consider human-controlled Level 1 drafting in this fictional scenario.
